newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Kuala Lumpur tin market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Kuala Lumpur tin market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Kuala Lumpur tin market is closed on Thursday for a Moslem holiday.
On Wednesday, the spot tin price fell nine cents to 13.79 ringgit ($5.36) a kg after players sold heavily on the metal due to an overnight slump on the London Metal Exchange (LME).
The closing price was at a premium of $15 against the LME after being at par on Tuesday.
Traders noted initial bids for 68 tonnes against offers for 139. Final turnover was 71 tonnes, against 217 on Tuesday, and was absorbed by Europeans, Japanese and locals.
